name: Custom Gut-Safe Gimbap (Korean Rice Rolls)
whyItWorks: Seasoned with sweet toasted sesame oil and salt instead of vinegar, with fully cooked fillings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Make or order Egg, Crab Stick, Bulgogi Beef, and American/Havarti Cheese Gimbap with peeled cucumber/zucchini ribbons. Skip burdock root, raw carrots, and spinach; use soy wrapper if flaring.
